g.text: Expose a definition with an equality lemma
apply_late_policy_unfold states that the function applicationequals its defining conditional expression. Its proof is reflexivity.
WORKED EXERCISE · NO PENALTY WITH FEWER THAN 9 DAYS

Theorem no_penalty_for_mostly_on_time : forall (late_days : nat) (g : grade), (late_days <? 9 = true) -> apply_late_policy late_days g = g.Proof. intros late_days g H. rewrite apply_late_policy_unfold. rewrite H. reflexivity.Qed.
if late_days <? 9 then g else ... = g→ if true then g else ... = g → g = g
